source.text_it: Se la frizione slitta è possibile che il disco sia imbrattato dall’olio del servocomando

records.localized_text: If the clutch slips, the disc may be contaminated by servo-control oil.

source.text_it: Se la frizione slitta è possibile che sia guasto il sistema di molle dello spingi-disco

records.localized_text: If the clutch slips, the pressure plate spring system may be faulty.

source.text_it: Se la frizione slitta e non si interviene è possibile che si verifichino danni maggiori a causa del surriscaldamento di tutto il meccanismo

records.localized_text: If a slipping clutch is not repaired, overheating of the whole mechanism may cause greater damage.

source.text_it: Se la frizione è a dischi multipli può essere del tipo "a bagno d’olio"

records.localized_text: A multi-disc clutch may be an oil-bath type.

source.text_it: Se la frizione è a disco unico è normalmente del tipo "a secco"

records.localized_text: A single-disc clutch is normally dry.

source.text_it: La frizione monodisco a secco è costituita da un grande disco di acciaio le cui superfici sono fornite di una guarnizione di attrito (ferodo)

records.localized_text: A dry single-disc clutch consists of a large steel disc whose surfaces have friction lining.

source.text_it: Alcuni autoveicoli sono dotati di frizione a dischi multipli

records.localized_text: Some motor vehicles have multi-disc clutches.

source.text_it: Nei mezzi pesanti la frizione viene comandata da un pedale, che aziona un servocomando che spesso utilizza aria compressa

records.localized_text: In heavy vehicles, the clutch pedal operates a servo control that often uses compressed air.

source.text_it: In molti autocarri e autobus di media portata, il pedale della frizione agisce su un servocomando a funzionamento idraulico

records.localized_text: In many medium-duty trucks and buses, the clutch pedal operates a hydraulic servo control.

source.text_it: A bordo di molti autobus, la trasmissione idraulica sostituisce la frizione ed il cambio meccanico

records.localized_text: On many buses, hydraulic transmission replaces the clutch and mechanical gearbox.

source.text_it: Se la trasmissione è idraulica non esistono la frizione meccanica e il relativo pedale

records.localized_text: With hydraulic transmission there is no mechanical clutch or corresponding pedal.

source.text_it: Con la frizione automatica, per ottenere la partenza del veicolo è sufficiente accelerare

records.localized_text: With an automatic clutch, accelerating is enough to start the vehicle moving.

source.text_it: Per evitare lo slittamento in fase di partenza, la frizione può essere sostituita da un collegamento a ingranaggi

records.localized_text: To prevent slipping during starting, the clutch may be replaced by a gear connection.

source.text_it: La frizione serve a mettere in collegamento direttamente il motore con gli assi delle ruote motrici

records.localized_text: The clutch directly connects the engine to the drive-wheel axles.

source.text_it: Il disco della frizione è in acciaio spazzolato ed è privo di qualsiasi rivestimento

records.localized_text: The clutch disc is brushed steel and has no lining.

source.text_it: Se la frizione è automatica il pedale è sostituito da un interruttore

records.localized_text: With an automatic clutch, a switch replaces the pedal.

source.text_it: La frizione ed il riduttore si trovano tra il cambio ed il differenziale

records.localized_text: The clutch and reduction gear are located between the gearbox and differential.

source.text_it: Se la frizione tende a slittare bisogna circolare senza cambiare mai marcia

records.localized_text: If the clutch tends to slip, drive without ever changing gear.

source.text_it: Se la frizione slitta può essere opportuno introdurvi gesso o sabbia dall’apposito sportellino

records.localized_text: If the clutch slips, it may be useful to insert chalk or sand through the special hatch.

source.text_it: E' sempre bene mantenere il piede appoggiato sulla frizione durante la marcia, in modo da velocizzare le cambiate di marcia

records.localized_text: It is always good to keep a foot resting on the clutch while driving to speed up gear changes.

source.text_it: La frizione è l’organo di trasmissione principale del cambio automatico

records.localized_text: The clutch is the main transmission component of an automatic gearbox.

source.text_it: I veicoli con 4 ruote motrici non necessitano di frizione

records.localized_text: Four-wheel-drive vehicles do not need a clutch.

source.text_it: I veicoli con doppio asse sterzante sono dotati di due frizioni separate

records.localized_text: Vehicles with two steering axles have two separate clutches.

source.text_it: Durante i mesi invernali vi è il rischio che la frizione si blocchi per formazione di ghiaccio al suo interno

records.localized_text: In winter there is a risk that the clutch will lock due to ice forming inside.

source.text_it: Se la frizione diventa "troppo dura" è bene togliere una delle sue molle di regolazione

records.localized_text: If the clutch becomes too stiff, one of its adjustment springs should be removed.

rows.text: A leak in the hydraulic control can contaminate the lining: oil reduces friction and the disc may slip.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — Hydraulic actuation leaks can oil facings and reduce friction.

rows.text: The pressure plate spring presses on the disc. If damaged, it can provide too little clamping force and cause slipping.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Diaphragm spring presses the pressure plate against disc and flywheel.

https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — A fractured diaphragm spring no longer provides its designed force; insufficient downforce causes slip.

rows.text: Continuous slipping produces excess heat: overheating can damage the lining and pressure plate.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — Continuous slip overheats and damages facings and pressure plate.

rows.text: A multi-disc clutch can run in an oil bath: multiple friction surfaces transmit torque in a compact space.
evidence: https://www.valeoservice.co.uk/en-uk/passenger-car/car-clutch-replacement-parts/dual-clutch — Wet clutches use multiple plates to compensate for lubricant-reduced friction.

rows.text: In vehicle transmissions, a single-disc clutch is commonly dry: its surfaces operate without an oil bath.
evidence: https://www.davuniversity.org/src/library/2025/MEC-263-Lab-Manual-Automobile-Engineering.pdf — p. 27: single plate clutch common in cars and light commercial vehicles; dry and wet versions exist.

https://dl.ojocv.gov.et/admin_/book/Automotive%20Engineering_%20Powertrain%2C%20Chassis%20System%20and%20Vehicle%20Body%20%28%20PDFDrive%20%29.pdf — Chapter 5.1: single-plate dry friction clutches commonly used with car manual gearboxes.

rows.text: The driven disc of a dry single-disc clutch has friction linings on both sides. They are clamped between the flywheel and pressure plate to transmit torque.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Pressure plate clamps disc against flywheel; clutch facings provide friction.
https://www.davuniversity.org/src/library/2025/MEC-263-Lab-Manual-Automobile-Engineering.pdf — p. 26–27: single plate friction surfaces and clutch assembly.

rows.text: Some vehicles have multi-disc clutches: the multiple friction surfaces transmit torque in a compact space.
evidence: https://www.valeoservice.co.uk/en-uk/passenger-car/car-clutch-replacement-parts/dual-clutch — Wet multi-plate dual clutches are fitted to vehicle transmissions.

rows.text: In manually operated heavy vehicles, the pedal can operate an air-assisted clutch servo, reducing the effort required from the driver.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/parts_catalogs/PB19028_web.pdf — p. 5-3: hydraulic clutch pedal and air-assisted clutch servos for commercial vehicles.

rows.text: A hydraulic control transmits pedal movement through a master cylinder and fluid to a clutch actuator, making operation easier.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — Master cylinder transmits pedal action hydraulically to slave cylinder; ZF commercial vehicle manual controls include hydraulic servos: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: an automatic transmission uses a torque converter and automatic selection instead of a driver-operated clutch pedal and manual shifting. It can still contain mechanical gears.
evidence: Official superiori 29566 VERO. ZF PowerLine https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_79552.html : torque converter and automatic eight-speed transmission; mechanical gears remain.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE for the absence of a conventional clutch pedal, but some automatic torque-converter transmissions have an internal mechanical lock-up clutch.
evidence: Official superiori 29567 VERO. ZF PowerLine https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_79552.html : converter includes an internal lock-up clutch; distinguish pedal-operated clutch.

rows.text: With a starting gear selected, the automatic system controls clutch engagement using the accelerator input among other signals, without requiring a clutch pedal.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/sg/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/trucks-trailers-and-buses/products/clutches/ — ConAct uses vehicle electronics and accelerator position for automatic clutch engagement, including starting.

rows.text: A rigid gear connection cannot replace progressive engagement: when starting, the clutch lets the engine and transmission gradually reach the same speed.
evidence: https://press.zf.com/press/en/releases/release_28224.html — Friction disc engages progressively for smooth starting.

rows.text: The clutch connects and disconnects the engine and gearbox input; the driveline continues through the differential to the driven wheels.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Clutch cover transmits torque via clutch disc to transmission input shaft.

rows.text: The driven disc of a conventional dry clutch has friction linings; it is not simply bare steel.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Clutch disc facings provide friction between flywheel and pressure plate.

rows.text: In an automated clutch, an actuator and control unit manage engagement; the driver does not replace the pedal with a simple switch.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html — Electronics and pneumatic actuator automatically control clutch release position.

rows.text: In the conventional layout, the clutch is between the engine and gearbox input, not between the gearbox and differential.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Engine torque passes through clutch disc to transmission input.

rows.text: Avoiding gear changes does not eliminate the cause of slipping. Have the clutch and its control checked, because continued slipping causes overheating.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — Check release system, friction surfaces and parts; continuous slip overheats clutch.

rows.text: Chalk or sand will not repair a slipping clutch. Friction surfaces must stay clean and the cause of the slipping must be found and corrected.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/ — Clean clutch housing and friction surfaces; diagnose causes of slip at https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/

rows.text: Resting a foot on the pedal can keep the release bearing loaded and accelerate its wear. Release the pedal after changing gear.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf — Riding clutch pedal continuously loads release bearing and increases wear.

rows.text: In a traditional automatic transmission, the torque converter transmits torque during takeoff and planetary gears provide the ratios; it can still contain internal clutches.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/PowerLine_Maintenance_Guide.pdf — Section 4.1: torque converter, lock-up clutch and downstream planetary gearset.

rows.text: Four-wheel drive concerns the distribution of torque to the wheels; it does not by itself eliminate the need for an engagement device between engine and gearbox.
evidence: https://www.davuniversity.org/src/library/2025/MEC-263-Lab-Manual-Automobile-Engineering.pdf — p. 27: clutch permits progressive engagement and disengagement of engine and transmission; axle drive does not determine clutch operation.

rows.text: Steering axles direct the vehicle; their number does not determine the number of transmission clutches.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_65885.html — Clutch transmits engine torque to gearbox input; steering axle count is a separate function.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but moisture and freezing can lock the disc to the flywheel in particular conditions: a GM bulletin documents this for certain models. It is not necessarily common to all heavy vehicles.
evidence: Official superiori 29580 FALSO. GM bulletin 09-07-31-002 reproduced at https://workshop-manuals.com/pontiac/solstice/l4-2.0l_turbo/relays_and_modules/relays_and_modules_accessories_and_optional_equipment/emergency_contact_module/component_information/technical_service_bulletins/all_other_service_bulletins_for_emergency_contact_module/09-07-31-002/may/09/m/t_clutch_may_not_release_in_cold_temps/ documents a model-specific freeze, not prevalence in heavy vehicles.

rows.text: A stiff pedal requires diagnosis of the control and clutch components. Removing a spring is not a correct adjustment and can compromise clamping force.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — Stiff actuation and spring defects are diagnostic causes; spring applies designed clamping force.

issues.reason: Il quiz dichiara vero che su molti autobus la trasmissione idraulica sostituisce frizione e cambio meccanico. Le fonti trovate mostrano un cambio automatico con convertitore idrodinamico ma anche ingranaggi planetari e frizione di blocco; non chiariscono se il quiz intenda solo la frizione comandata a pedale e il cambio manuale né verificano la frequenza della configurazione letterale.
checked_sources: ZF PowerLine Maintenance Guide, sezione 4.1, https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/PowerLine_Maintenance_Guide.pdf — convertitore idrodinamico, frizione di blocco e gruppo planetario a 8 rapporti.
ZF PowerLine, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_79552.html — cambio automatico per autobus con convertitore e frizione di blocco integrata.

issues.reason: Il verdetto vero afferma senza condizioni che con trasmissione idraulica non esiste una frizione meccanica. Un convertitore idrodinamico per autobus può invece includere una frizione meccanica di blocco: non è chiaro se il quesito intenda soltanto la frizione tradizionale comandata a pedale.
checked_sources: ZF PowerLine Maintenance Guide, sezione 4.1, https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/PowerLine_Maintenance_Guide.pdf — convertitore idrodinamico con frizione di blocco e ingranaggi planetari.

issues.reason: Il verdetto falso nega il rischio di blocco per ghiaccio, ma un bollettino di assistenza del costruttore descrive proprio una frizione che gela sul volano quando entra umidità e la temperatura scende sotto zero. Il testo non esclude tale circostanza; occorre adjudicare il conflitto.
checked_sources: General Motors, bollettino 09-07-31-002, maggio 2009, riprodotto in https://workshop-manuals.com/saturn/sky/l4-2.0l_turbo/transmission_and_drivetrain/clutch_m/t/clutch_disc_m/t/component_information/technical_service_bulletins/customer_interest/09-07-31-002/may/09/m/t_clutch_may_not_release_in_cold_temps/ — umidità nell’alloggiamento può congelare il disco sul volano e impedire il disinnesto.

ZF, Commercial Vehicle Clutch actuator service information 12847 EN, 03.2020, https://aftermarket.zf.com/app/controller/ti/download/Binary/260f3a23-39dc-11ec-a2e1-00505690da53.pdf — umidità o corrosione nel circuito pneumatico possono causare guasti all’attuatore.
